audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart says 'Skill' on rows 2-4 and 2+ items while content and packet say Lux owns levels 1-5 and Swain takes over at two-plus items.
audit.why: Her 1175-range Q and 1100-range E outrange everything Swain has pre-6 and he has no dash to punish; at two-plus items her single rotation no longer bursts a tank-mage and any longer fight is his.
audit.corrected: phases[1..3].side to Lux, phases[6].side to Swain, whys and ratings rewritten to match. Rows 6 and First item stay Skill, agreeing with both layers.

audit.why: Spikes correctly frame her 3-5 poke window, the 6 skill read (Final Spark vs drain), the even first-item race, and your late outscale.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns field had no numbers; the Illumination auto-reset burst tell (flagged missing interaction) was absent; do/don't bullets were pasted trade lines.
audit.why: Light Binding is 10s flat and everything keys off it; Prismatic Barrier is 12s and blunts trades; her combo opens with the Illumination auto wind-up, which is the step-back cue.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns and shield timing in breakdown.cooldowns; the auto-reset tell in dontsFull[2].d; bullet bodies rewritten to match titles.
